players.product: Atlas and Origin agentic target-to-antibody discovery platform

quarterly_data.signal: August 2026 corporate presentation (EX-99.2) on the ABS-201 HEADLINE Phase 1/2a trial: double-blind, placebo-controlled, first-in-human, multi-site study in Australia of up to 227 participants: SAD n=32 healthy volunteers in four IV cohorts (150mg, 450mg, 900mg and 1800mg, n=8 each); MAD (26 weeks) n=147 AGA subjects (Norwood Scale IIIv-V) in three SC cohorts (300mg, 600mg and 1200mg, n=49 each); optional PHL cohorts n=48; 3:1 randomization. Initiated December 2025; all planned SAD cohorts dosed and MAD Cohort 3 enrolling (as of May 31, 2026). Modeling of interim HEADLINE PK data puts s.c. bioavailability at ~70% (popPK) and supports 2-3 s.c. injections over a six-month period (e.g., 400 mg/injection, illustrative and not a final dose) maintaining >90% receptor occupancy without cycling; dose range finding is ongoing in the MAD portion.
quarterly_data.figure: up to 227 participants; SAD n=32 (150mg to 1800mg IV); MAD n=147 (300mg to 1200mg SC); ~70% s.c. bioavailability

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 release and August deck (EX-99.1 / EX-99.2) on the wider pipeline: the planned Phase 2 of ABS-201 in endometriosis has potential proof-of-concept data in the second half of 2027, and the deck says ABS-201 has potential to generate >$4.5B at peak sales in endometriosis, with ~9M U.S. patients. ABS-101 for IBD (anti-TL1A) 'demonstrated improved half-life and tissue penetration vs 1st gen TL1a molecules and ready for partnering'; the deck cites 3 clinical-stage programs and a preclinical pipeline focused on metabolism and I&I. For pattern hair loss the deck adds a >$40B potential global TAM and 5-9M patients treated per year assuming 2-3 year durability (market research commissioned by Absci); in the 610-participant survey 37% of men and 36% of women would try ABS-201 first (first line).
quarterly_data.figure: endometriosis PoC 2H 2027; >$4.5B endometriosis peak sales; >$40B potential global PHL TAM; 5-9M patients treated per year

quarterly_data.signal: August deck (EX-99.2) validation data for ABS-201: in a 21-day hair regrowth model ABS-201 showed superior efficacy vs 5% topical minoxidil; in human ex vivo male scalp culture it prolonged anagen / inhibited catagen, stimulated hair matrix proliferation, restored CD34+ progenitor cells, raised IGF1 and FGF7 and decreased the catagen driver TGF-beta 2; UK Biobank genetics in 165,649 men show balding severity scaling with PRLR expression (odds ratio 1.35 per SD for severe balding grade 4 vs grade 1), with cis-MR colocalization PP.H4 = 0.96 supporting a causal role. A stumptailed macaque study (40mg/kg s.c. Q2W for 28 weeks; commissioned by Absci CIO Andreas Busch while at Bayer, disclosed by a competitor) showed a >100 hairs/cm2 increase in bald area at week 28, with hair growth remaining several years after cessation; in an endometriosis mouse model PRLR antagonism reduced lesion formation and pain.
quarterly_data.figure: superior to 5% topical minoxidil (21-day model); 165,649 men, odds ratio 1.35; >100 hairs/cm2 at week 28 in macaques
